class Address(int column, int row, fixed_column := false, fixed_row := false)
class Rectangle(Address first, Address last)
class FormulaNode(string tag, number := 0, word := "", left := 0, right := 0, int[] arguments := [], first := Address(0, 0), last := Address(0, 0))
class Value(string tag, number := 0, word := "", rectangle := Rectangle(Address(0, 0), Address(0, 0)))
class Token(string tag, string word, int position, root := 0)
class Parser(Token[] tokens, cursor := 0)
class History(string command, int[] contents)
class Sheet(FormulaNode[] nodes, int[] contents, Value[] values, int[][] dependencies, History[] history)
class Pair(string first, string rest)

bool one_of(string sought, const string[] choices)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == sought
            return true
    return false

int[] empty_indices()
    return []

int compare_text(string left_text, string right_text)
    int[] left_codes := left_text.codepoints()
    int[] right_codes := right_text.codepoints()
    shared := if #left_codes < #right_codes then int(#left_codes) else int(#right_codes)
    for: 0 <= offset < shared
        if left_codes[offset] < right_codes[offset]
            return -1
        if left_codes[offset] > right_codes[offset]
            return 1
    return if #left_codes < #right_codes then -1 elif #left_codes > #right_codes then 1 else 0

bool digit(string character)
    return character != "" and "0123456789".contains(character)

bool letter(string character)
    return character != "" and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

string upper(string source)
    result := ""
    for: offset < #source
        match "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".find(source[offset])
            nat position
                result += "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[position]
            none
                result += source[offset]
    return result

Pair split_first(string source)
    match source.find(" ")
        nat position
            return Pair(source[:<position], source[position + 1:])
        none
            return Pair(source, "")

bool valid_row(string source)
    if #source < 1 or #source > 2
        return false
    return "123456789".contains(source[0]) and (#source == 1 or digit(source[1]))

int column_number(string character)
    match "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".find(character)
        nat position
            return int(position)
        none
            return -1

Address | error parse_address(string source)
    if #source < 2
        return error("bad address")
    column := column_number(source[0])
    if column < 0 or not valid_row(source[1:])
        return error("bad address")
    row := int(source[1:])
    return Address(column, row - 1)

Rectangle normalized(Address first, Address last)
    if first.column > last.column
        saved_column := first.column
        saved_column_flag := first.fixed_column
        first.column = last.column
        first.fixed_column = last.fixed_column
        last.column = saved_column
        last.fixed_column = saved_column_flag
    if first.row > last.row
        saved_row := first.row
        saved_row_flag := first.fixed_row
        first.row = last.row
        first.fixed_row = last.fixed_row
        last.row = saved_row
        last.fixed_row = saved_row_flag
    return Rectangle(first, last)

Rectangle | error parse_rectangle(string source)
    parts := source.split(":")
    if #parts > 2
        return error("bad address")
    first := try parse_address(parts[0])
    last := first
    if #parts == 2
        last = try parse_address(parts[1])
    return normalized(first, last)

bool inside(Address cell)
    return 0 <= cell.column < 26 and 0 <= cell.row < 99

int cell_index(Address cell)
    return cell.row * 26 + cell.column

string cell_label(int index)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[index % 26] + "{index / 26 + 1}"

bool contains(Rectangle rectangle, Address cell)
    return rectangle.first.column <= cell.column <= rectangle.last.column and rectangle.first.row <= cell.row <= rectangle.last.row

int[] rectangle_cells(Rectangle rectangle)
    int[] result := []
    for: rectangle.first.row <= row <= rectangle.last.row
        for: rectangle.first.column <= column <= rectangle.last.column
            result = result.append(row * 26 + column)
    return result

int append_node(FormulaNode[] &nodes, FormulaNode item)
    result := int(#nodes)
    nodes = nodes.append(item)
    return result

int precedence(string operation)
    if one_of(operation, ["=", "<>", "<", "<=", ">", ">="])
        return 0
    if operation == "&"
        return 1
    if operation == "+" or operation == "-"
        return 2
    if operation == "*" or operation == "/"
        return 3
    return -1

Address | none read_reference(string word)
    cursor := 0
    fixed_column := false
    fixed_row := false
    if word[0] == "$"
        fixed_column = true
        cursor += 1
    if cursor >= int(#word)
        return none
    column := column_number(word[cursor])
    if column < 0
        return none
    cursor += 1
    if cursor < int(#word) and word[cursor] == "$"
        fixed_row = true
        cursor += 1
    suffix := word[cursor:]
    if not valid_row(suffix)
        return none
    row := int(suffix)
    return Address(column, row - 1, fixed_column, fixed_row)

Token[] | error tokenize(string source, FormulaNode[] &nodes)
    Token[] result := []
    cursor := 1
    size := int(#source)
    while cursor < size
        character := source[cursor]
        position := cursor + 1
        if character == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        if digit(character)
            ending := cursor
            while ending < size and digit(source[ending])
                ending += 1
            if ending - cursor >= 10
                return error("syntax error at {position}")
            number := int(source[cursor:<ending])
            root := append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("N", number))
            result = result.append(Token("value", "", position, root))
            cursor = ending
        elif character == DQ
            ending := cursor + 1
            while ending < size and source[ending] != DQ
                ending += 1
            if ending == size
                return error("syntax error at {position}")
            root := append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("S", word = source[cursor + 1:<ending]))
            result = result.append(Token("value", "", position, root))
            cursor = ending + 1
        elif letter(character) or character == "$"
            ending := cursor
            while ending < size and (letter(source[ending]) or digit(source[ending]) or source[ending] == "$")
                ending += 1
            word := upper(source[cursor:<ending])
            cursor = ending
            match read_reference(word)
                Address target
                    root := append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("R", first = target))
                    result = result.append(Token("reference", "", position, root))
                none
                    valid := column_number(word[0]) >= 0
                    for: offset < #word
                        if column_number(word[offset]) < 0 and not digit(word[offset])
                            valid = false
                    if not valid
                        return error("syntax error at {position}")
                    while ending < size and source[ending] == " "
                        ending += 1
                    if ending < size and source[ending] == "("
                        result = result.append(Token("call", word, position))
                    else
                        root := append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("W", word = word))
                        result = result.append(Token("value", "", position, root))
        else
            if not "+-*/&(),:=<>".contains(character)
                return error("syntax error at {position}")
            operation := character
            if cursor + 1 < size
                pair := source[cursor:<cursor + 2]
                if pair == "<>" or pair == "<=" or pair == ">="
                    operation = pair
            result = result.append(Token("symbol", operation, position))
            cursor += int(#operation)
    return result.append(Token("end", "", size + 1))

bool take(Parser &parser, string symbol)
    current := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
    if current.tag == "symbol" and current.word == symbol
        parser.cursor += 1
        return true
    return false

void | error expect(Parser &parser, string symbol)
    if not take(&parser, symbol)
        return error("syntax error at {parser.tokens[parser.cursor].position}")
    return void

int | error primary(Parser &parser, FormulaNode[] &nodes);

int | error expression(Parser &parser, FormulaNode[] &nodes, level := 0)
    if level == 4
        return try primary(&parser, &nodes)
    left := try expression(&parser, &nodes, level + 1)
    while parser.tokens[parser.cursor].tag == "symbol" and precedence(parser.tokens[parser.cursor].word) == level
        operation := parser.tokens[parser.cursor].word
        parser.cursor += 1
        right := try expression(&parser, &nodes, level + 1)
        left = append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("B", word = operation, left = left, right = right))
    return left

int | error primary(Parser &parser, FormulaNode[] &nodes)
    if take(&parser, "-")
        operand := try primary(&parser, &nodes)
        return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("U", left = operand))
    current := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
    parser.cursor += 1
    if current.tag == "value"
        return current.root
    if current.tag == "reference"
        if not take(&parser, ":")
            return current.root
        last := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
        if last.tag != "reference"
            return error("syntax error at {last.position}")
        parser.cursor += 1
        rectangle := normalized(nodes[current.root].first, nodes[last.root].first)
        return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("G", first = rectangle.first, last = rectangle.last))
    if current.tag == "call"
        try expect(&parser, "(")
        int[] arguments := []
        if not take(&parser, ")")
            arguments = arguments.append(try expression(&parser, &nodes))
            while take(&parser, ",")
                arguments = arguments.append(try expression(&parser, &nodes))
            try expect(&parser, ")")
        return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("F", word = current.word, arguments = arguments))
    if current.tag == "symbol" and current.word == "("
        operand := try expression(&parser, &nodes)
        try expect(&parser, ")")
        return operand
    return error("syntax error at {current.position}")

int | error parse_formula(string source, FormulaNode[] &nodes)
    tokens := try tokenize(source, &nodes)
    parser := Parser(tokens)
    root := try expression(&parser, &nodes)
    if parser.tokens[parser.cursor].tag != "end"
        return error("syntax error at {parser.tokens[parser.cursor].position}")
    return root

string reference_text(Address target)
    return (if target.fixed_column then "$" else "") + "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[target.column] + (if target.fixed_row then "$" else "") + "{target.row + 1}"

string canonical(const FormulaNode[] nodes, int root)
    item := nodes[root]
    if item.tag == "N"
        return "{item.number}"
    if item.tag == "S"
        return DQ + item.word + DQ
    if item.tag == "W"
        return item.word
    if item.tag == "X"
        return "#REF!"
    if item.tag == "R"
        return reference_text(item.first)
    if item.tag == "G"
        return reference_text(item.first) + ":" + reference_text(item.last)
    if item.tag == "F"
        string[] arguments := []
        for child := item.arguments[]
            arguments = arguments.append(canonical(nodes, child))
        return item.word + "(" + arguments.join(",") + ")"
    if item.tag == "U"
        operand := canonical(nodes, item.left)
        return "-" + (if nodes[item.left].tag == "B" then "(" + operand + ")" else operand)
    left := canonical(nodes, item.left)
    right := canonical(nodes, item.right)
    if nodes[item.left].tag == "B" and precedence(nodes[item.left].word) < precedence(item.word)
        left = "(" + left + ")"
    if nodes[item.right].tag == "B" and precedence(nodes[item.right].word) <= precedence(item.word)
        right = "(" + right + ")"
    return left + item.word + right

string display(Value item)
    if item.tag == "Z"
        return ""
    if item.tag == "N"
        return "{item.number}"
    return item.word

string notation(Value item)
    if item.tag == "Z"
        return "(empty)"
    if item.tag == "S"
        return DQ + item.word + DQ
    return display(item)

string content_notation(const FormulaNode[] nodes, int root)
    item := nodes[root]
    if item.tag == "="
        return "=" + canonical(nodes, item.left)
    return notation(Value(item.tag, item.number, item.word))

Value to_number(Value item)
    if item.tag == "Z"
        return Value("N")
    if item.tag == "S" or item.tag == "G"
        return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
    return item

Value to_text(Value item)
    if item.tag == "Z"
        return Value("S")
    if item.tag == "N"
        return Value("S", word = "{item.number}")
    if item.tag == "G"
        return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
    return item

Value evaluate(const FormulaNode[] nodes, const Value[] values, int root)
    item := nodes[root]
    if item.tag == "N" or item.tag == "S"
        return Value(item.tag, item.number, item.word)
    if item.tag == "R"
        return values[cell_index(item.first)]
    if item.tag == "G"
        return Value("G", rectangle = Rectangle(item.first, item.last))
    if item.tag == "W"
        return Value("E", word = "#NAME?")
    if item.tag == "X"
        return Value("E", word = "#REF!")
    if item.tag == "U"
        operand := to_number(evaluate(nodes, values, item.left))
        return if operand.tag == "E" then operand else Value("N", -operand.number)
    if item.tag == "B"
        left := evaluate(nodes, values, item.left)
        right := evaluate(nodes, values, item.right)
        if left.tag == "E"
            return left
        if right.tag == "E"
            return right
        if precedence(item.word) == 0
            if left.tag == "G" or right.tag == "G"
                return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
            strings := left.tag == "S" or right.tag == "S"
            if left.tag == "Z"
                left = Value(if strings then "S" else "N")
            if right.tag == "Z"
                right = Value(if strings then "S" else "N")
            order := 0
            if left.tag != right.tag
                order = if left.tag == "N" then -1 else 1
            elif left.tag == "N"
                order = if left.number < right.number then -1 elif left.number > right.number then 1 else 0
            else
                order = compare_text(left.word, right.word)
            relation := if item.word == "=" then order == 0 elif item.word == "<>" then order != 0 elif item.word == "<" then order < 0 elif item.word == "<=" then order <= 0 elif item.word == ">" then order > 0 else order >= 0
            return Value("N", if relation then 1 else 0)
        left = if item.word == "&" then to_text(left) else to_number(left)
        right = if item.word == "&" then to_text(right) else to_number(right)
        if left.tag == "E"
            return left
        if right.tag == "E"
            return right
        if item.word == "&"
            return Value("S", word = left.word + right.word)
        if item.word == "+"
            return Value("N", left.number + right.number)
        if item.word == "-"
            return Value("N", left.number - right.number)
        if item.word == "*"
            return Value("N", left.number * right.number)
        return if right.number == 0 then Value("E", word = "#DIV/0!") else Value("N", left.number / right.number)
    name := item.word
    aggregate := one_of(name, ["SUM", "MIN", "MAX", "COUNT", "AVERAGE", "AND", "OR", "CONCAT"])
    if aggregate
        if #item.arguments == 0
            return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
        Value[] items := []
        for argument := item.arguments[]
            computed := evaluate(nodes, values, argument)
            if computed.tag == "G"
                for index := rectangle_cells(computed.rectangle)[]
                    items = items.append(values[index])
            else
                items = items.append(computed)
        count := 0
        total := 0
        minimum := 0
        maximum := 0
        every := true
        some := false
        joined := ""
        for entry := items[]
            if entry.tag == "N"
                if count == 0 or entry.number < minimum
                    minimum = entry.number
                if count == 0 or entry.number > maximum
                    maximum = entry.number
                count += 1
                total += entry.number
                every = every and entry.number != 0
                some = some or entry.number != 0
        if name == "COUNT"
            return Value("N", count)
        for entry := items[]
            if entry.tag == "E"
                return entry
            joined += to_text(entry).word
        if name == "CONCAT"
            return Value("S", word = joined)
        if name == "SUM"
            return Value("N", total)
        if name == "MIN"
            return Value("N", minimum)
        if name == "MAX"
            return Value("N", maximum)
        if count == 0
            return Value("E", word = if name == "AVERAGE" then "#DIV/0!" else "#VALUE!")
        if name == "AVERAGE"
            return Value("N", total / count)
        return Value("N", if (if name == "AND" then every else some) then 1 else 0)
    if name == "IF"
        if #item.arguments != 2 and #item.arguments != 3
            return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
        condition := to_number(evaluate(nodes, values, item.arguments[0]))
        if condition.tag == "E"
            return condition
        if condition.number != 0
            return evaluate(nodes, values, item.arguments[1])
        return if #item.arguments == 3 then evaluate(nodes, values, item.arguments[2]) else Value("N")
    if name != "ABS" and name != "NOT" and name != "LEN"
        return Value("E", word = "#NAME?")
    if #item.arguments != 1
        return Value("E", word = "#VALUE!")
    scalar := evaluate(nodes, values, item.arguments[0])
    scalar = if name == "LEN" then to_text(scalar) else to_number(scalar)
    if scalar.tag == "E"
        return scalar
    if name == "LEN"
        return Value("N", int(#scalar.word))
    if name == "ABS"
        return Value("N", if scalar.number < 0 then -scalar.number else scalar.number)
    return Value("N", if scalar.number == 0 then 1 else 0)

void collect_dependencies(const FormulaNode[] nodes, int root, bool[] &found)
    item := nodes[root]
    if item.tag == "R"
        found[cell_index(item.first)] = true
    elif item.tag == "G"
        for index := rectangle_cells(Rectangle(item.first, item.last))[]
            found[index] = true
    elif item.tag == "U" or item.tag == "B" or item.tag == "="
        collect_dependencies(nodes, item.left, &found)
        if item.tag == "B"
            collect_dependencies(nodes, item.right, &found)
    elif item.tag == "F"
        for child := item.arguments[]
            collect_dependencies(nodes, child, &found)

class Topology(int[][] edges, bool[] formulas, int[] indices, int[] low, bool[] active, bool[] cyclic, int[] stack, serial := 0)

void visit(Topology &graph, int index)
    graph.indices[index] = graph.serial
    graph.low[index] = graph.serial
    graph.serial += 1
    graph.stack = graph.stack.append(index)
    graph.active[index] = true
    for next := graph.edges[index][]
        if graph.formulas[next]
            if graph.indices[next] < 0
                visit(&graph, next)
                if graph.low[next] < graph.low[index]
                    graph.low[index] = graph.low[next]
            elif graph.active[next] and graph.indices[next] < graph.low[index]
                graph.low[index] = graph.indices[next]
    if graph.low[index] == graph.indices[index]
        int[] component := []
        while true
            last := graph.stack[-1]
            graph.stack = graph.stack[:<int(#graph.stack) - 1]
            graph.active[last] = false
            component = component.append(last)
            if last == index
                break
        self_edge := false
        for next := graph.edges[index][]
            if next == index
                self_edge = true
        if #component > 1 or self_edge
            for member := component[]
                graph.cyclic[member] = true

void calculate(const FormulaNode[] nodes, const int[] contents, const int[][] edges, const bool[] cyclic, int index, bool[] &done, Value[] &values)
    root := contents[index]
    if nodes[root].tag != "=" or done[index]
        return
    done[index] = true
    if cyclic[index]
        values[index] = Value("E", word = "#CYCLE!")
        return
    for next := edges[index][]
        calculate(nodes, contents, edges, cyclic, next, &done, &values)
    computed := evaluate(nodes, values, nodes[root].left)
    values[index] = if computed.tag == "Z" then Value("N") elif computed.tag == "G" then Value("E", word = "#VALUE!") else computed

int replace_contents(Sheet &sheet, int[] replacement)
    previous := sheet.values
    sheet.contents = replacement
    sheet.values = array(2574, fill = Value("Z"))
    sheet.dependencies = array(2574, fill = empty_indices())
    formulas := array(2574, fill = false)
    for: 0 <= index < 2574
        item := sheet.nodes[sheet.contents[index]]
        if item.tag == "="
            formulas[index] = true
            found := array(2574, fill = false)
            collect_dependencies(sheet.nodes, item.left, &found)
            for: 0 <= other < 2574
                if found[other]
                    sheet.dependencies[index] = sheet.dependencies[index].append(other)
        else
            sheet.values[index] = Value(item.tag, item.number, item.word)
    graph := Topology(sheet.dependencies, formulas, array(2574, fill = -1), array(2574, fill = 0), array(2574, fill = false), array(2574, fill = false), [])
    for: 0 <= index < 2574
        if formulas[index] and graph.indices[index] < 0
            visit(&graph, index)
    done := array(2574, fill = false)
    for: 0 <= index < 2574
        calculate(sheet.nodes, sheet.contents, sheet.dependencies, graph.cyclic, index, &done, &sheet.values)
    count := 0
    for: 0 <= index < 2574
        if previous[index] != sheet.values[index]
            count += 1
    return count

class RewriteContext(string mode, source := Rectangle(Address(0, 0), Address(0, 0)), destination := Rectangle(Address(0, 0), Address(0, 0)), columns := 0, rows := 0, row_axis := true, position := 0, limit := 99, insertion := false)

Address shifted(Address target, RewriteContext context, bool relative)
    if not relative or not target.fixed_column
        target.column += context.columns
    if not relative or not target.fixed_row
        target.row += context.rows
    return target

int axis(Address target, bool row_axis)
    return if row_axis then target.row else target.column

Address with_axis(Address target, bool row_axis, int coordinate)
    if row_axis
        target.row = coordinate
    else
        target.column = coordinate
    return target

int rewrite(FormulaNode[] &nodes, int root, RewriteContext context)
    item := nodes[root]
    if item.tag == "R"
        target := item.first
        if context.mode == "COPY"
            target = shifted(target, context, true)
        elif context.mode == "MOVE"
            if contains(context.source, target)
                target = shifted(target, context, false)
            elif contains(context.destination, target)
                return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("X"))
        else
            coordinate := axis(target, context.row_axis)
            if not context.insertion and coordinate == context.position
                return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("X"))
            if context.insertion and coordinate >= context.position
                coordinate += 1
            elif not context.insertion and coordinate > context.position
                coordinate -= 1
            target = with_axis(target, context.row_axis, coordinate)
        if not inside(target)
            return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("X"))
        item.first = target
    elif item.tag == "G"
        first := item.first
        last := item.last
        if context.mode == "COPY"
            first = shifted(first, context, true)
            last = shifted(last, context, true)
        elif context.mode == "MOVE"
            if not contains(context.source, first) or not contains(context.source, last)
                return root
            first = shifted(first, context, false)
            last = shifted(last, context, false)
        else
            start := axis(first, context.row_axis)
            ending := axis(last, context.row_axis)
            if not context.insertion and start == context.position and ending == context.position
                return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("X"))
            if context.insertion
                if start >= context.position
                    start += 1
                if ending >= context.position
                    ending += 1
            else
                if start > context.position
                    start -= 1
                if ending >= context.position
                    ending -= 1
            first = with_axis(first, context.row_axis, start)
            last = with_axis(last, context.row_axis, ending)
        if not inside(first) or not inside(last)
            return append_node(&nodes, FormulaNode("X"))
        rectangle := normalized(first, last)
        item.first = rectangle.first
        item.last = rectangle.last
    elif item.tag == "U" or item.tag == "B" or item.tag == "="
        item.left = rewrite(&nodes, item.left, context)
        if item.tag == "B"
            item.right = rewrite(&nodes, item.right, context)
    elif item.tag == "F"
        for: offset < #item.arguments
            item.arguments[offset] = rewrite(&nodes, item.arguments[offset], context)
    else
        return root
    return append_node(&nodes, item)

bool valid_integer(string source)
    if source == "0"
        return true
    digits := if source.starts_with("-") then source[1:] else source
    if #digits == 0 or #digits > 9 or not "123456789".contains(digits[0])
        return false
    for: offset < #digits
        if not digit(digits[offset])
            return false
    return true

string describe(const Sheet sheet, int index)
    return cell_label(index) + ": " + content_notation(sheet.nodes, sheet.contents[index]) + " -> " + notation(sheet.values[index])

string format_cells(int[] indices)
    if #indices == 0
        return "none"
    string[] labels := []
    for index := indices.sorted()[]
        labels = labels.append(cell_label(index))
    return labels.join(",")

string padded(string source, int width, align_right := false)
    string padding := " " * nat(width - int(#source))
    return if align_right then padding + source else source + padding

string[] | error execute(Sheet &sheet, string line)
    command := split_first(line)
    name := command.first
    argument := command.rest
    if name == "SHOW"
        target := try parse_address(argument)
        return [describe(sheet, cell_index(target))]
    if name == "LIST"
        string[] output := []
        for: 0 <= index < 2574
            if sheet.contents[index] != 0
                output = output.append(describe(sheet, index))
        return if #output == 0 then ["(no cells)"] else output
    if name == "DEPS"
        target := try parse_address(argument)
        index := cell_index(target)
        int[] dependents := []
        for: 0 <= other < 2574
            for precedent := sheet.dependencies[other][]
                if precedent == index
                    dependents = dependents.append(other)
                    break
        return [argument + ": precedents=" + format_cells(sheet.dependencies[index]) + " dependents=" + format_cells(dependents)]
    if name == "PRINT"
        rectangle := try parse_rectangle(argument)
        row_width := int(#"{rectangle.last.row + 1}")
        int[] widths := []
        string separator := "+" + "-" * nat(row_width) + "+"
        string heading := "|" + " " * nat(row_width) + "|"
        for: rectangle.first.column <= column <= rectangle.last.column
            width := 1
            for: rectangle.first.row <= row <= rectangle.last.row
                size := int(#display(sheet.values[row * 26 + column]))
                if size > width
                    width = size
            widths = widths.append(width)
            separator += "-" * nat(width) + "+"
            heading += padded("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[column], width) + "|"
        output := [separator, heading, separator]
        for: rectangle.first.row <= row <= rectangle.last.row
            rendered := "|" + padded("{row + 1}", row_width, true) + "|"
            for: rectangle.first.column <= column <= rectangle.last.column
                entry := sheet.values[row * 26 + column]
                rendered += padded(display(entry), widths[column - rectangle.first.column], entry.tag == "N") + "|"
            output = output.append(rendered)
        return output.append(separator)
    if name == "UNDO"
        if #sheet.history == 0
            return error("nothing to undo")
        previous := sheet.history[-1]
        sheet.history = sheet.history[:<int(#sheet.history) - 1]
        count := replace_contents(&sheet, previous.contents)
        return ["UNDO {previous.command} changed={count}"]
    draft := sheet.contents
    set_index := -1
    if name == "SET"
        parts := split_first(argument)
        target := try parse_address(parts.first)
        set_index = cell_index(target)
        source := parts.rest
        if source.starts_with("=")
            tree := try parse_formula(source, &sheet.nodes)
            draft[set_index] = append_node(&sheet.nodes, FormulaNode("=", left = tree))
        elif #source >= 2 and source[0] == DQ and source[#source - 1] == DQ and not source[1:<int(#source) - 1].contains(DQ)
            draft[set_index] = append_node(&sheet.nodes, FormulaNode("S", word = source[1:<int(#source) - 1]))
        elif valid_integer(source)
            number := int(source)
            draft[set_index] = append_node(&sheet.nodes, FormulaNode("N", number))
        else
            return error("bad value")
    elif name == "CLEAR"
        rectangle := try parse_rectangle(argument)
        for index := rectangle_cells(rectangle)[]
            draft[index] = 0
    elif name == "COPY" or name == "MOVE"
        parts := split_first(argument)
        source := try parse_rectangle(parts.first)
        target := try parse_address(parts.rest)
        columns := target.column - source.first.column
        rows := target.row - source.first.row
        context := RewriteContext(name, source = source, columns = columns, rows = rows)
        destination := Rectangle(shifted(source.first, context, false), shifted(source.last, context, false))
        if not inside(destination.first) or not inside(destination.last)
            return error("out of grid")
        context.destination = destination
        if name == "MOVE"
            for: 0 <= index < 2574
                draft[index] = rewrite(&sheet.nodes, draft[index], context)
        indices := rectangle_cells(source)
        int[] moving := []
        for index := indices[]
            moving = moving.append(if name == "COPY" then rewrite(&sheet.nodes, sheet.contents[index], context) else draft[index])
        if name == "MOVE"
            for index := indices[]
                draft[index] = 0
        for: offset < #indices
            draft[indices[offset] + rows * 26 + columns] = moving[offset]
    elif one_of(name, ["INSERTROW", "DELETEROW", "INSERTCOL", "DELETECOL"])
        row_axis := name.ends_with("ROW")
        insertion := name.starts_with("INSERT")
        position := 0
        if row_axis
            if not valid_row(argument)
                return error("bad address")
            position = int(argument) - 1
        else
            if #argument != 1 or column_number(argument) < 0
                return error("bad address")
            position = column_number(argument)
        limit := if row_axis then 99 else 26
        if insertion
            for: 0 <= index < 2574
                coordinate := if row_axis then index / 26 else index % 26
                if sheet.contents[index] != 0 and coordinate == limit - 1
                    return error("last " + (if row_axis then "row" else "column") + " not empty")
        context := RewriteContext("LINES", row_axis = row_axis, position = position, limit = limit, insertion = insertion)
        draft = array(2574, fill = 0)
        for: 0 <= index < 2574
            if sheet.contents[index] == 0
                continue
            target := Address(index % 26, index / 26)
            coordinate := axis(target, row_axis)
            if not insertion and coordinate == position
                continue
            if insertion and coordinate >= position
                coordinate += 1
            elif not insertion and coordinate > position
                coordinate -= 1
            target = with_axis(target, row_axis, coordinate)
            draft[cell_index(target)] = rewrite(&sheet.nodes, sheet.contents[index], context)
    else
        return error("unknown command")
    sheet.history = sheet.history.append(History(name, sheet.contents))
    count := replace_contents(&sheet, draft)
    suffix := if name == "SET" then " " + cell_label(set_index) + "=" + notation(sheet.values[set_index]) else ""
    return [name + suffix + " changed={count}"]

sheet := Sheet([FormulaNode("Z")], array(2574, fill = 0), array(2574, fill = Value("Z")), array(2574, fill = empty_indices()), [])
int count
scan(&count)
for: 0 <= command_index < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match execute(&sheet, line)
        string[] output
            for rendered := output[]
                println(rendered)
        error problem
            println("ERROR {problem.message}")
